summary: Become a physical shadow (+3 to Stealth and Defense. Suffers a -2 to affect her surroundings)

title: Vanish
summary: Become invisible (-5 to detect the character. Rules of Fighting Blind apply)

title: Crushing Blow
summary: Inflict Lethal damage with unarmed strike or melee weapon (instead of bashing damage)

title: Mighty Bound
summary: Make incredible jump (+6 to Jumping)

title: Iron Rending
summary: Damage objects (cancels 1 point of Durability or Armor per success)

title: Legendary Arm
summary: Throw to amazing distance (allows throwing an object with a size double her Strength without usual penalty due to object's size)

title: Savage Might
summary: Gain inhuman strength (+3 to Strength per Essence point spent)

title: Bloody Moon
summary: Suffer a -2 penalty on all rolls to avoid entering Death Rage. Gain an additional +1 to Strength, Dexterity and Stamina, above and beyond the normal bonuses associated with Gauru form

title: Gravid Moon
summary: Grants an extra die per success on all Social interactions for the remainder of the scene and drains Willpower from any ordinary humans within a radius equal to 10 yards per dot of the Bale Hound’s Primal Urge

title: Broken Moon
summary: The target automatically enters Death Rage, changes to Gauru form and attacks the first thing at hand

title: Sickle Moon
summary: The spirit suffers one point of damage per success on the Bale Hound’s attack

title: Dark Moon
summary: The target loses all sensory input, becoming blind, deaf and unable to smell or feel the world around him. Werewolves must immediately check for Death Rage

title: Left-Handed Spanner
summary: Disable a device for 1 turn per success

title: Nightfall
summary: Extinguish all artificial light in the vicinity

title: Iron Treachery
summary: Make a device turn against its user (reduces dice polls for using the object to a chance die for 1 turn per success)

title: Machinegeist
summary: Possess a machine (gains perception and information, but cannot control it)

title: Create Technology
summary: Craft a device

title: Lay of the Land
summary: Learn the population of a Territory, as well as seeing the totem of the pack that claims it

title: Minor Sending
summary: Send a whispered message to a packmate while on your territory

title: Sense of the Territory
summary: Learn the location of all Loci, Werewolves and spirits Rank 3 or higher

title: Animate the Land
summary: A chosen skill either receives bonuses for packmates or penalties for enemies

title: Disrupt Essence
summary: All powers cost twice as much essence for non-pack members

title: Find Conflict
summary: Find the biggest and most fierce conflict in an area

title: Notice Defeat
summary: Reflexively notice that a group of allies is in trouble

title: Whispers on the Wind
summary: Send a message to any number of people in an area

title: Echoes of Opposing Brilliance
summary: Learn the tactics of the opposing commander

title: Shared Battle Mind
summary: Give soldiers a subtle instinctive push to act in according to the tactics the commander chooses

title: Ward Versus Predator
summary: Protect a territory against predatory animals (requires Resolve + Composure to enter the territory)

title: Ward Versus Humans
summary: Protect a territory against humans (requires Resolve + Composure to enter the territory)

title: Technology Ward
summary: Disable all devices in the vicinity (mechanical devices reduce all rolls to a chance roll)

title: Shadow Ward
summary: Strengthen the Gauntlet (-1 to crossing or seeing through the Gauntlet)

title: Ward of Spirit Slumber
summary: Put all spirits in the vicinity to sleep

title: Warrior's Insight
summary: Unlimited use of the Warrior's Eye

title: Battle Mind
summary: Resist mental influence

title: Hobbling Gaze
summary: Slow a fleeing opponent

title: Bloodletting
summary: Inflict an hemoragy

title: Might of the Full Moon
summary: Wear gauru form as long as wished

title: Reflection
summary: Change a Chance roll to one die

title: Shallow Heart
summary: Select a new Vice for the subject that replaces the old one for a scene

title: Coward’s Soul
summary: Inflicts feelings of guilt and depression in the victim. She cannot gain Willpower until she sleeps well.

title: Hidden Self
summary: Hide weakness from onlookers (Vice, low attribute, low harmony or derangement), making them effectively of average statistics for game mechanics.

title: Wrack
summary: Make target suffer severe depression and self-loathing for 2 turns per success. She may take actions only spending Willpower and her defense is 0. After recovering, she must do a degeneration roll.

title: Call the Breeze
summary: Summon light wind (-1 to Perception rolls)

title: Silent Fog
summary: Summon a patch of fog (-2 to Perception rolls)

title: Deluge
summary: Summon a heavy rain (-2 to Perception and ranged combat rolls)

title: Killing frost
summary: Summon a hard frost wave (2 points of bashing damage, -2 to Strength and Dexterity rolls)

title: Thunderbolt
summary: Summon a thunderbolt upon his opponent (4 points + 1 per success of lethal damage)

title: Shadow-Speaking
summary: Act as a vessel for spirits to speak

title: Shadow Discord
summary: Reduce spirits influence in a zone

title: Luck-Eating
summary: Transfer luck from target to the Ithaeur

title: Cage the Rider
summary: Emprison a spirit into the Ithaeur body

title: Poisoned Essence
summary: Make essence expenditure to deal damage

title: The Heart of Things
summary: Add Wisdom to any Mental or Social roll to infer knowledge for a scene

title: Befuddle
summary: Target suffers penalty equal to Ithaeur Wisdom on mental rolls

title: The Wisdom of Patience
summary: Skip a turn in combat to gain various benefits to next attack

title: Mothers Counsel
summary: Add Ithaeur's Wisdom as an equipment bonus to another's skill for 24 hours

title: Forbidden Knowledge
summary: Target does not make the next roll, instead automatically gets success equal to Ithaeur's Wisdom

title: Form Lock
summary: Make it harder for a werewolf to shapeshift

title: Patronless Pack
summary: Temporarily remove Totem benefits for a pack

title: Return to Birth
summary: Force a werewolf into human form

title: Human Health
summary: Remove werewolf regeneration

title: Object of Piercing Clarity
summary: Witnesses view target as if they had +4 Willpower for purposes of Lunacy

title: Wound-Born
summary: The Bale Hound becomes immune to the foul resonance emanating out from a Wound. He no longer suffers the penalties of entering and interacting within Wounds

title: Lord of the Wounds
summary: To Wound-born spirits, the Bale Hound now appears as one of the Maeltinet. Any Bale Hound with this Gift adds a +2 bonus on all rolls to bargain, bribe or command spirits

title: Blessing of Pain
summary: The target is suddenly wracked with sickness, and suffers all the penalties of entering a Wound. The effects last for one turn per success on the roll

title: Siphon Suffering
summary: The target is struck by powerful feelings of apathy and lethargy. The Bale Hound gains a point of Essence, and the human suffers a -1 to all dice rolls until she next sleeps and recovers with rest.

title: Communion With the Wounds
summary: The character immediately gains full knowledge of all Wounds within a 5-mile radius, their proximity to loci, the number of spirits around the areas, the name of the Maeltinet present within each (if any) and general terrain features. When…

title: Concrete Bolt-Hole
summary: Secure a minor hiding place in the city, adding a +2 to Stealth rolls.

title: Foot In The Door
summary: Gain access over the phone to an expert or contact necessary for one's needs.

title: Windfall
summary: Receive a bounty from the city that must be returned once its necessity is expired.

title: Urban Awareness
summary: Gain total awareness of what happens in an urban area.

title: Vermin Riot
summary: Call up the vermin of the city to attack a target (-2 to any Skill, -2 to Speed, 1 bashing damage per turn)

title: Backstage Synchronicity
summary: When working with the pack members in harmony to come up with new ideas and clever plans, they get a bonus with their wits and restore essence.

title: Destoyer’s Jaws, The
summary: Whenever you fill an enemy’s rightmost Health box, that enemy dies instantly

title: Eyes of Death Wolf
summary: Exchange your eyes with the eyes of Death Wolf, so it can can see into or out of the Shadow merely by concentrating, identify Ridden and other possessed beings on site and know the name of any spirit he encounters.

title: Hunter’s Bounty, The
summary: Allows to replenish essence simply by hunting and catching food

title: Storm’s Whisper
summary: Once per game session, one member of her pack to receive a blessing (+2 to any rolls) and one to receive castigation (-2 to any rolls)

title: Thief of Shadows
summary: Become able to purchase the supernatural powers of any other creatures

title: Words of Power
summary: Once per chapter, may resolve any rite as an instant action instead of an extended action.

title: Absolute Authority
summary: Any Empathy, Investigation, or Politics rolls made to uncover truth are Rote Actions, sees everything, including ghosts and spirits in Twilight, can send the restless dead on to whatever awaits them, banish spirits to the Shadow and humans…

title: Songs of Uplifting Glory
summary: If use willpower to enhance a roll, if tthe roll fails, count the roll as having a single success. If the roll succeeds with fewer than five successes, consider to have resulted in five successes. If are attained five or more successes, do…

title: Luna's Gaze
summary: Can always see in even pitch dark, become impossible to surprise, cannot fail rolls to spot hidden opponents.

title: Rites
summary: Explains how werewolves learn rites, how rite descriptions are structured, how rites can be disrupted, and the general modifiers used when performing them.

title: Avowed Soldier, Rite of the
summary: Target becomes official supporter of war and gains benefits of war totem's blessing.

title: Banish Human
summary: Cast a targeted human out of the spirit world and back into the material (includes Mages)

title: Blood Ogham
summary: Creates ogham rune that warns (only) Uratha and wolf-bloods that territory is claimed.

title: Blood’s Revelation, Rite of
summary: The ritualist steals some memories from a subject.

title: Chiminage Rite
summary: Target gains one point of Essence per dot of the ritemaster’s Wisdom. Ritemaster gains a +2 bonus on Gifts, rites, and Social rolls against target.

title: Condemnation, Rite of
summary: Target loses benefit of war totem's blessing, and -1 penalty to social rolls among rites audience for 1 month.

title: Contrition, Rite of
summary: The Pure's variant of the Forsaken's two dot version of this ritual, the primary distinction is the subject must remain out of the sight of the moon for an extended period while gathering the necessary successes.

title: Dedication, Rite of
summary: Imbues an item with the ability to shapeshift along with a designated owner, such that it is not destroyed or dropped during the change. Also allows the item to be brought into the Shadow Realm. A character may bind up to his Primal Urges…

title: Demonstration of Obedience
summary: Vows faith to Father Wolf's decrees and binds one subject to a specific law, granting a bonus to Harmony rolls for other rituals so long as the law is observed.

title: Duel, Rite of the
summary: Creates a dueling zone, in which any lethal damage inflicted from weapons is downgraded to bashing.

title: Fair Warning, Rite of
summary: Lupines entering area protected with this rite instinctively feel as if they are interlopers, and get +2 bonus when attempting to find territory markers.

title: Final Howl, Rite of the
summary: Ritualist howls and is able to transmit his location, a message and emotional undercurrent to all that hear. Used only in dire circumstances.

title: First Blood, Rite of
summary: Performed when Blood Talon has received first battle wound, grants 3 XP which must be spent towards Glory renown.

title: Funeral Rite
summary: Speeds the spirit of a deceased werewolf onward into the afterlife.

title: Ghost Howl, Rite of the
summary: Infuses an area with a haunting growl, which persists until the day of the ritemaster's death. Serves as a warning to spirits and other Uratha alike.

title: Hallowed Ground, Rite of
summary: Ritemaster sings of his glory to the spirits of his territory. If he is judged well the Ritemaster gains 2 essence or entire pack gains 1 essence each.

title: Honor the Benevolent Spirit
summary: Brands a rune upon a spirit which means "Honored". Werewolves must protect the spirit if it calls for aid.

title: Howl of Ownership
summary: Alerts spirits in the area that the pack has claimed its territory and challenges spirits to face them if they dispute the claim.

title: Luna’s Acre, Rite of
summary: Consecrates a graveyard for 1 year. Those that come and pray can gain back 1 willpower point once per week.

title: Packstone
summary: Ritemaster and pack create packstone. Activating packstone allows owner to detect what direction, how far and the physical health of each packmate regardless of distance.

title: Penance, Rite of
summary: A painful and torturous rite that seeks the forgiveness of the founder of the Fire-Touched tribe, this ritual can free the subject of derangement acquired due to Harmony loss.

title: Renunciation, Rite of
summary: This rite is the polite procedure for departing from a tribe respectfully; still costs one Renown dot.

title: Ritual Mind
summary: Ritemaster gains 1 die to Harmony roll for other rite, but can only be used to offset penalties, not to gain extra dice.

title: Scent of the Einherjar
summary: Allows ritemaster to track fallen Uratha worthy of the Funeral Rite up to 1 mile per point of Primal Urge.

title: Shared Scent
summary: Allows a pack to together follow a scent and track a target, provided one of their number has smelled it recently.

title: Silver Road, Rite of the
summary: Target is judged by Luna for Crusade. If accepted the supplicant may learn Silver Road gifts and rites and immediately gain their new Auspice abilities.

title: Sorrow Marks - Mirrayindri
summary: Wounds the target with aggravated damage, and while wounds still open ghosts receive -3 penalty to oppose target. Once healed over and only scars remain, ghosts receive -1 penalty.

title: Spirit Brand, Rite of the
summary: Prompts the Lunes to assess a werewolf and increase his Renown.

title: Spirit’s Promise, Rite of the
summary: Determines spirits ban.

title: Taste of the Ancestors
summary: A rite which tests the blood of a subject, which can determine if either of their parents were werewolves, and if so whether they were aligned with the SotM or the Pure.

title: Tremulous Howl, The
summary: Ritemaster howls and alerts all werewolves within 20 miles per dot of Primal Urge that he is in dire trouble. All who hear know who is in trouble and where, but not what the cause is.

title: Anticipated Forgiveness, Rite of
summary: Target gains 1 die to degeneration rolls made for killing Werewolves for the next hour, but must be genuinely repentant.

title: Banish Spirit
summary: Attempts to banish a spirit from the material world back into the Shadow Realm.

title: Bar to Birth
summary: Target cannot become pregnant due to intercourse with human for one lunar month.

title: Beseech the Mother
summary: Cahalith ritemaster entreats Luna for prophetic dreams.

title: Blademaster, Rite of the
summary: Binds spirits into glyphs painted on targets bodies that can grant a dot in Brawl, Weaponry or Firearms; or a dot in any Fight Style merit; or one point of armor; or three specialties in Brawl, Weaponry or Firearms. Skill and Fight Style d…

title: Blessing of the Spirit Hunt
summary: Imbues a werewolf's teeth and claws with the ability to harm a spirit in Twilight as if it were manifest (not needed in Shadow Realm)

title: Cairn Stones, Rite of the
summary: Beseeches a memory spirit to remember the deeds of the departed Uratha forever.

title: Call Gaffling
summary: Attempts to summon a low ranked spirit.

title: Call Human
summary: Plants an irresistible compulsion in the nearest human within five miles to approach the ritualist's location. The character may not choose a specific target, but wolf-blooded are more susceptible,

title: Call the Cloudless Sky
summary: Changes weather into cloudless sky for 10 minutes per dot of ritemasters Primal Urge.

title: Carrion Messenger
summary: Can deliver a clear message to another member of the Lodge of Crows anywhere in the world, regardless of location.

title: Churned Earth, Rite of
summary: Buried objects within an affected area come to the surface.

title: Cleansed Blood
summary: Any creature currently tracking the subject of the ritual by the scent of their blood loses the trail.

title: Communion of the Flesh
summary: Grants a bonus to Stamina and Resolve rolls to all those who have recently consumed human flesh.

title: Create Talen
summary: Creates a Talen

title: Dizzying Wind, Rite of the
summary: Ritemaster deducts dots from skill he possesses and adds to a skill he does possess. The amount of dots is limited by the ritemasters Primal Urge and the duration is 12 hours.

title: Dormancy, Rite of
summary: Temporarily squelches a Locus for up to a lunar month. It gives a -4 penalty to finding the locus and it cannot be tapped for Essence. However, any werewolf may spend 1 Essence point to revive it.

title: Eyes of the City
summary: Learn broad information about city, or more specific information about smaller areas.

title: Fires of Jarrah - Parnrdriyindri
summary: Allows ritemaster to purchase back lost Harmony point.

title: Fortify the Border Marches
summary: Modify the strength of the Gauntlet by 1 in a small area for up to one hour.

title: Fresh Scent
summary: Target's scent, hair, fur color, and facial structure undergo a change. The rite imposes a -5 dice penalty to track the target and lasts for one week.

title: Hallow Touchstone
summary: Imbue an appropriate item with some of the Essence from a Loci (up to 3 points); this can be tapped by any werewolf later, either slowly and efficiently, or reflexively and for only a single point. The touchstone bleeds 1 point of Essence…

title: Hunter’s Howl, Rite of the
summary: All wolves who set out on hunt receive essence but the hunt must be a virtuous one.

title: Invoke Kletba
summary: Issues a curse from Gift, rite or fetish upon a target.

title: Lesser Oath, Rite of the
summary: Participants of an oath must abide by the agreement or risk Harmony (level 7) loss and the appearance of a glyph denoting shame being added to their spirit brands.

title: Mark of Change
summary: Imbue body modifications with spirits for one month. This bestows upon the wearer 9 again on Auspice abilities as well as the ability to spend X essence to increase an auspice by X dots for one roll.

title: Oath of the Rose
summary: Bestows upon a vow the full protection of the Rose Shield.

title: Purgation, Rite of
summary: A rite typically performed by packs of Fire-Touched on a monthly basis, this rite allows all members with at least Harmony 7 to buy back Harmony dots lost due to tribal ban violation at half cost.

title: Rouse the Fetish
summary: Ritemaster can communicate with a spirit inside a fetish. It will reveal it's nature, rank and the purpose of the fetish.

title: Ruined Tongue, Rite of the
summary: Renders target unable to speak of a specific topic.

title: Scarlet Messenger
summary: Creates short lived spirit to carry a message for up to 1 mile per success.

title: Shroud, Rite of the
summary: Hides a Bale Hound's allegiance to Maeljin Incarna from Luna and the Forsaken.

title: Silent Hunt
summary: Leave no mark and go unnoticed so long as stalking and observing.

title: Sin-Eater, Rite of the
summary: Bale Hound gives Chiminage to Soulless Wolf. For next lunar month ritemaster gains +2 dice to Harmony rolls for rites and stepping sideways. May spend extra essence to increase Dice Pool.

title: Speak with the Guardian
summary: The ritemaster is possessed by the incredibly powerful totem spirit of the Lodge of Cerberus, who will then answer three questions to the best of his ability.

title: Surrogate, Rite of the
summary: Prepares the subject to deal with a transgression they plan to commit in the next 24 hours; grants a bonus to resist degeneration once the sin is performed.

title: Strip the Soul Bare
summary: A powerful rite, designed to torment captive Forsaken, which strips them of Willpower and the ability to enter death rage. Using it is a significant Harmony violation.

title: Winter’s Anguish, Rite of
summary: Target is immune to natural cold for 1 hour per dot of ritemaster's Primal Urge.

title: Ajogun, Rite of
summary: Within area of effect people get lost and sense of direction fails them. Area affected equals 1 square mile per 3 essence spent and lasts 1 hour for every point of Primal Urge of the ritemaster.

title: Apples and Oranges
summary: Ritemaster can determine similarities between objects, and can even ask specific questions about the target object.

title: Bestowing the Shadowblind Cloak
summary: Cast upon a mortal, the target is ignored by spirits for one lunar month. High rank spirits get to roll to resist.

title: Bind Human
summary: Wards an area, such that a particular human cannot leave, or that no humans can enter. In order to pass, humans must roll to resist the effects or else satisfy some condition determined by the ritualist. Also effective against Mages.

title: Bind Spirit
summary: As Bind Human, but for Spirits. I doesn't work on ghosts.

title: Blood Communion of Spring
summary: Seasonal rite bestows upon participants 4 discretionary dice that may be used for social interactions that may be used during the next lunar month. Participants also receive -1 to composure checks and +1 to stamina checks for the duration.

title: Bone Club, Rite of the
summary: Ritemaster imbues a bone taken from the victim of his intended target and casts rite upon it. For 3 days, or until the target is killed the ritemaster can use the bone as a club that deals aggravated damage to the target only, and the rite…

title: Boundary Stone, Rite of the
summary: Creates a stone in the Hisil that denotes territory marking to any being that possesses Essence trait that sees it. One stone must be created for each Cardinal point.

title: Call Jaggling
summary: As Call Gaffling, but calls a higher ranked spirit. Werewolves without a Renown trait of 3+ will be treated with open contempt.

title: Call the Empty Road
summary: All humans of willpower 4 or less, except for target, feel antipathy towards certain area and will avoid it

title: Centering the Cairn
summary: Sanctifies a Cairn and imbues the area with several properties. Attacking another werewolf has a -4 penalty (but not defending) but can spend a willpower point to ignore the penalty; when approaching Cairn werewolves get 1 die bonus to Emp…

title: Comprehension, Rite of
summary: Allows the ability to comprehend a foreign language, written or spoken.

title: Courage of the Fallen
summary: Ritualist gains 1 willpower point for each health level of preys flesh consumed.

title: Eshu’s Blessing
summary: Curses a target as a focal point of chaos. Anyone within 10 yards of targets loses 10 again and 1's subtract from rolls for 1 hour per point the ritemaster has in Primal Urge.

title: Expiate the Sin
summary: By sacrificing a captured Forsaken warrior, the ritualist and his pack may in some small part atone for the murder of Father Wolf, potentially relieving them of one of their degeneration-caused derangement. However, this rite is a signific…

title: Eyes of Sagrim-Ur
summary: The subject's perceptions are altered, highlighting opportunities that he would not otherwise see. The character adds a +2 circumstance bonus on all rolls made to improvise equipment or otherwise try something he would not normally attempt.

title: Final Sunrise, Rite of the
summary: Performed on a living being on the verge of death, or on a machine that is broken beyond repair, this rite brings the subject to an end but grants those involved a significant boon of Essence.

title: Found, Rite of the
summary: Imbues the ritualist with knowledge of the location of nearby werewolves who have not yet experienced the first Change.

title: Forbidden Flesh, Rite of
summary: After consuming the flesh of a human, werewolf, or wolf-blood, the ritualist may use this rite to gain increased strength and stamina for a time.

title: Grave’s Bounty, Rite of the
summary: Lets the ritualist see and hear through a mortal resident of the city for a number of hours equal to Harmony.

title: Healing, Rite of
summary: Heals up to 5 aggravated damage points at a rate of two Essence per point; the Essence may come from the ritualist or those healed. The healed points may be divided in any number of targets, including the ritemaster. Works only on Werewolv…

title: Information Gestalt
summary: Duplicates Omen Gazing as a Harmony-based rite, using a meditative trance before multiple television screens.

title: Initiation, Rite of
summary: Initiates a Werewolf into a new tribe.

title: Maenads, Rite of the
summary: Augurs whether a specific course of action is likely to end well, badly, or both.

title: Mark of the Black Wolf
summary: Brands a trespasser with a spiritual mark that warns other werewolves and reveals something wrong with the target.

title: Moon’s Love, Rite of the
summary: Grants a wolf-blooded subject enhanced ability to resist Lunacy for 1 month (+2 to Willpower for Lunacy's effects purposes)

title: Moon’s Veil, Rite of the
summary: Grants a Pure subject the Lune's favor, and an increased ability to hide from werewolves and spirits for a number of days depending on the essence spent by the Ritemaster.

title: New Coat, Rite of the
summary: Transforms the appearance of Pure renown into Forsaken renown within the Hisil.

title: Offal, Rite of
summary: All man-made refuse within an affected area turns into a foul slime, which acts as a powerful fertilizer.

title: Open Moon Gate
summary: Opens a prepared lunar road between two loci, allowing Forsaken to travel quickly and safely through the Shadow.

title: Purity, Rite of
summary: This rite, performed on a werewolf who has not yet experienced the First Change, ensures that when they do they will not awaken with an auspice.

title: Sacred Hunt
summary: Begins a ritual hunt of a designated spirit, which must consent. After the ritual, the pack has twenty four hours to catch the released spirit and tear it to shreds, devouring its Essence; as part of the ritual, the spirit will survive if…

title: Sacred Vigil
summary: Grants altered sight that reveals supernatural auras, Twilight beings, Hosts, Ridden, and Claimed, but compels the werewolf to hunt.

title: Salon, The
summary: Participants complete a 24-hour ceremonial celebration, restoring Willpower, healing aggravated damage, and gaining a temporary Attribute bonus.

title: Shackle Spirit
summary: Binds troublesome spirit into state of near slumber. Spirit not capable of movement, reasoning or employing any powers. The spirit can be plied for simple information (not gifts).

title: Shrieking Glyphs
summary: Bale Hound creates glyph that marks Iduth-Su to help other Bale Hounds find Flayed Ones. Glyph repels werewolves with high harmony.

title: Sleeping Seer, Rite of the
summary: Sends participants into a mystic slumber and shared dream of the coming End Times.

title: Subduing Hungers Rite
summary: No need to eat or drink for number of days equal to essence spent during ritual.

title: To The Cannon’s Mouth
summary: Lets the ritualist see and hear through a mortal resident of the city for a number of hours equal to Harmony.

title: Wake the Spirit
summary: Awaken a dormant spirit, which possesses no loyalty or concern for the ritualist.

title: Waken the Fell Wolf
summary: Temporarily awakens the predatory spirit of dogs or enhances wolves, creating a temporary pack for hunting or defense.

title: Waters of Songkran
summary: Creates purified water that will cause aggravated damage to Hosts, Ridden and Forsaken with a Harmony of 3 or less. Any werewolf hit by water reverts to Hishu and cannot Death Rage, regardless of circumstances. Water loses potency after nu…

title: Alpha’s Blessing, Rite of
summary: A pack swears fealty to the ritemaster, and in turn they gain bonuses to Wits and Resolve until sunrise. Should any member break their vows to the ritemaster, they lose the bonus.

title: Angry Streets, Rite of
summary: Warns a section of a city of hostile intruders; until the next sunrise, the city becomes actively hostile to these targets.

title: Battle Brand, Rite of the
summary: Marks warriors before battle, granting attack bonuses and making enemies hesitate against branded beneficiaries.

title: Binding of Looks
summary: All locks within one city block become locked.

title: Blinding the Eye
summary: Using a personal possession of a subject, the ritualist strikes the victim blind for a short time. The blindness lasts only minutes in Uratha, but several hours in humans.

title: Bloody-Handed Hunter
summary: Stains hands blood red to the wrist for one night but can be ended prematurely if the werewolf desires. All claw attacks inflict +1 aggravated damage.

title: Bone-Fires of Summer
summary: Seasonal rite bestows upon participants 6 discretionary dice that may be used for combat s that may be used during the next lunar month.

title: Chosen Ground, Rite of
summary: Colors the resonance of a locus at the heart of a pack's territory according to their desires, giving a +1 to all appropriate rolls inside the territory for 1 year.

title: Claws of Ashes
summary: Claw attacks inflict +2 Aggravated damage until sunrise.

title: Corrosion, Rite of
summary: Corrodes an object, granting 9-again property to all attempts to break it for the remainder of the scene.

title: Darkest Night of Winter
summary: Seasonal rite bestows upon participants 6 discretionary dice that may be used towards enduring mental of physical hardship during the next lunar month.

title: Dead Light, Rite of
summary: Transforms a Lune into an Iduth-Su.

title: Desert Rain
summary: Temporarily restores Essence flow to a Barren, allowing the area to begin healing with repeated effort.

title: Essence Fence, Rite of the
summary: Creates fence in the Hisil for up to 1 lunar month. Within the fence Essence may not be taken or traded. Loci cannot be tapped although personal reserves of essence may be spent. The fence may be visible or invisible.

title: Fetish Rite
summary: Creates a new Fetish; costs one Essence per dot of the Fetish, as well as requiring a spirit to be so bound.

title: Forge Lunar Road
summary: Links two loci with a lunar road, preparing them for fast travel through the Open Moon Gate rite.

title: Forging Arms
summary: Used for initiation into the Lodge of Arms, this rite binds a subject and a weapon as permanent companions.

title: Greater Oath, Rite of the
summary: Binds two groups of Uratha and their totems to a powerful oath, granting benefits while fulfilled and serious consequences if broken.

title: Hikaon’s Trail, Rite of
summary: Reveals a trail to a sought place, object, person, or spirit, greatly shortening the journey if the werewolf does not leave the path.

title: Obon Temae
summary: Ritemaster shares meal with Yokai and can force it to answer specific questions that are based on the meal served.
